DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: フロントでございます。お部屋で何かございましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Front desk speaking. Has something happened in your room?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 部屋の机に荷物が置いてありますが、宛名が私と違います。開けずに連絡した方がよいと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 部屋の机に自分以外の宛名の荷物があり開封していないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: There is a parcel on the desk in my room, but the addressee is not me. I thought I should contact you without opening it.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that there is a parcel addressed to someone else on your room's desk and you have not opened it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご連絡ありがとうございます。部屋番号と、お荷物が置かれていた位置を伺えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: Thank you for contacting us. Could you tell me your room number and where the parcel was placed?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 五〇八号室で、入口側の机の上です。今チェックインして初めて部屋へ入りました。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 五〇八号室の入口側の机でチェックイン後初めて入室したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: Room five-oh-eight, on the desk near the entrance. I have just checked in and entered the room for the first time.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is on the entrance-side desk in room five-oh-eight and you have just entered for the first time after checking in. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 確認のため係を伺わせます。荷物はそのままの場所に置いていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will send a staff member to check. Could you leave the parcel in the same place?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そのままにします。これから夕食へ出たいので、出る前に受け取りに来ていただけると助かります。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 荷物を動かさず夕食へ出る前に回収してほしいと依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will leave it there. I would like to go out for dinner, so it would help if someone could collect it before I leave.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask for collection before you go out for dinner while leaving the parcel untouched. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係の到着までの時間を確認します。すぐ伺えない場合は、持ち出さずにフロントへお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check how soon the staff member can arrive. If we cannot come immediately, please notify the front desk without taking it out of the room.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。部屋に入ってよいかどうかは、私が出る前に直接お話しして決めたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 出る前に係と直接話して入室の可否を決めたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I would like to speak directly before leaving and decide whether staff may enter the room.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you want to speak directly with the staff member before leaving to decide whether entry is permitted. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入室の希望も係へ伝えます。荷物の宛名をほかのお客様に見せたり、廊下へ置いたりしないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will tell the staff member your wishes about entry too. Please do not show the addressee to other guests or leave the parcel in the corridor.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宛名は誰にも見せず、廊下にも出しません。係の方と会って渡してから、夕食へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛名を他人に見せず廊下へ出さず係に会って荷物を渡してから出かけると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will not show the addressee to anyone or put it in the corridor. I will meet the staff member and hand it over before going to dinner.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will not show the addressee or leave the parcel in the corridor, and will meet staff to hand it over before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 係の手配を確認して折り返します。ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、夕食の時間もどうぞお楽しみください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check the staff arrangements and call you back. Thank you for your cooperation. Please enjoy dinner as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 風が強くなっていますので、周囲の案内にご注意ください。お連れの方はいらっしゃいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: The wind is getting stronger, so please pay attention to the directions around you. Is anyone here with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 妻と来ています。街の景色を撮りたかったのですが、帽子も飛びそうなので、今は風を避けられる所へ戻りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 妻と来たが強風のため街の撮影をやめ風を避けられる所へ戻りたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am here with my wife. I wanted to photograph the city view, but even my hat looks likely to blow away, so I would like to return to somewhere sheltered from the wind now.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you came with your wife but want to stop photographing the city and return to shelter because of the strong wind. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人ともこちらにいらっしゃいますね。柵の近くへ寄らず、係の案内に沿って移動してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Both of you are here, then. Please stay away from the fence and move according to the staff's directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 妻はこの後ろにいます。帰りの道は来た階段ですか。それとも、別の通路が開いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 妻が後ろにいると伝え来た階段か別の通路で戻るか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: My wife is just behind here. Do we return by the stairs we came up, or is a different passage open?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that your wife is behind you and ask whether to return by the original stairs or another passage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 現在利用できる戻り道を確認します。足を止めて、この壁側の安全な位置でお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check which return route is currently available. Please stop and wait in this safe spot beside the wall.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 壁側で待ちます。写真のために外へ残るのはやめて、二人一緒に戻ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 壁側で待ち写真のために外へ残らず二人一緒に戻ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: We will wait beside the wall. We will not stay outside for photos, and we will go back together.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait beside the wall and return together rather than remain outside for photos. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 担当者に確認できました。こちらの通路を案内します。移動中は携帯をしまい、手すりを使ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: I have checked with the person in charge. I will guide you along this passage. Put away your phone and use the handrail while moving.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 携帯を袋に入れました。荷物が片手を塞ぐので、肩に掛け直してから歩きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 携帯をしまい荷物を肩へ掛け直して片手を空けたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have put my phone in my bag. My luggage is occupying one hand, so I will put it back over my shoulder before walking.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you put your phone away and want to free one hand by putting your luggage over your shoulder. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 準備ができたら、前の方と間隔を空けて進みましょう。急いで追い越さないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you are ready, let us move with space between you and the person ahead. Please do not rush to overtake.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 荷物を掛け直せました。妻と距離を空けずに進み、前の人が止まったら私たちも止まります。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 荷物の準備ができ妻と離れず前の人が止まれば止まると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have adjusted my luggage. I will stay close to my wife as we move, and if the person ahead stops, we will stop too.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that your luggage is ready, you will stay with your wife, and will stop if the person ahead stops. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、こちらからご案内します。撮影は無理のない日にお楽しみください。それでは、帰りの移動もお気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will guide you from here. Enjoy photography on a day when conditions allow it comfortably. Take care on your way back.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の受け取りでしょうか。お控えをお持ちでしたら見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you collecting an order? Please show me your receipt if you have it.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 焼き菓子を予約したリムです。この店だと思って来ましたが、注文票の印が違う気がします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 焼き菓子を予約したリムだが注文票の印が店と違う気がすると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am Lim, and I ordered baked sweets. I came thinking this was the shop, but the mark on the order slip seems different.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are Lim, who ordered baked sweets, but the mark on the order slip seems different from the shop's. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 控えの店名を拝見しますね。当店ではなく、同じ通りの別のお店のお名前が書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let me look at the shop name on your receipt. It is not our shop; it is the name of another shop on this street.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 同じ色の看板だったので勘違いしました。注文先へは、この通りをそのまま進めばよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同じ色の看板で勘違いしたと説明し注文先へ通りを進めばよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: I mistook it because the sign was the same color. To get to the shop I ordered from, should I keep going along this street?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain the confusion due to the same-colored sign and ask whether to continue along the street to the correct shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 店の場所が書かれた地図を見てみましょう。私は今日の営業状況までは分からないので、注文票の連絡先も確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us look at the map showing the shop's location. I do not know whether it is open today, so please also check the contact details on the order slip.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 受取時刻が四時で、今は三時五十分です。歩く前に電話して、場所と受取を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四時受取で今は三時五十分なので電話で場所と受取を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Collection is at four, and it is three fifty now. Before walking, I will call to confirm the location and collection.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that collection is at four and it is now three fifty, so you will call to check the location and collection. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの端で電話していただけます。ほかのお客様の通路を空けてお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-07.translation: You can make the call at this side. Please leave the passage clear for other customers while waiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 邪魔にならない端へ移ります。電話がつながらなければ、注文票にある住所を見て探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 端へ移って電話しつながらなければ注文票の住所で探すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will move to the side where I will not be in the way. If the call does not connect, I will look for it using the address on the order slip.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will move to the side to call and, if unable to connect, use the order slip's address to find the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 住所はここにあります。似た名前の店と混同しないよう、建物の番号もご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: The address is here. Please also check the building number to avoid confusing it with a similarly named shop.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 番号も見ました。この店では受け取れないことが分かったので、注文票を持って正しい店へ向かいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 建物番号を確認し注文票を持って注文先へ向かうと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked the number too. Now that I know I cannot collect it here, I will take the order slip and go to the correct shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you checked the building number and will take the order slip to the shop you ordered from. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 控えをお返しします。受取先で店名をお確かめくださいね。それでは、道中お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your receipt back. Please check the shop name at the collection location. Take care on your way.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 説明札を読んでいらっしゃいますね。展示についてご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: You are reading the exhibit label. Do you have any questions about the display?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この道具の札に複製とあります。昔の人が実際に使った物ではなく、後から作った物という意味ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 展示品が当時使われた実物ではなく後から作られた物か尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: The label for this tool says “replica.” Does that mean it was made later rather than actually used by people in the past?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether the exhibit was made later rather than being the original used at the time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ここでいう複製は、元の資料を参考に作った展示用の物です。実物と区別してご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: Here, “replica” means an item made for display using the original artifact as a reference. Please distinguish it from the original.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: なるほど。学校の感想文に本物を見たと書こうとしていましたが、それでは違いますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 本物を見たと感想文に書く予定だったが誤りになると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: I see. I was going to write in my school reflection that I saw the real thing, but that would be wrong.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm that your planned statement in a school reflection that you saw the original would be incorrect. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 実物ではなく複製を見た、と書くと正確になります。形や使い方を学んだことも書けますね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: It would be accurate to write that you saw a replica, not the original. You can also write what you learned about its shape and use.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、形を観察したことを書きます。元の資料がどこにあるか、この札に書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 形の観察を書くと伝え元の資料の場所が札に記載されているか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will write about observing the shape. Does this label say where the original artifact is?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will write about observing the shape and ask whether the label gives the original's location. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 所蔵先の記載を一緒に確認しましょう。書かれていない情報は資料担当へ確認できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Let us check together for information on the collection holding it. You can ask the collection staff about information that is not written there.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 札には所蔵先が見つかりません。今日は分からないまま書かず、複製だったことだけメモします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所蔵先が見つからず推測せず複製だったことだけメモすると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I cannot find the collection's location on the label. Today I will not write it without knowing; I will just note that this was a replica.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you cannot find the collection's location and will not guess, but will note only that it was a replica. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: それがよいと思います。資料の名前も一緒に控えると、後で問い合わせる時に特定しやすくなります。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: That sounds good. If you also note the artifact's name, it will be easier to identify when you inquire later.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 展示番号と資料名をノートに写します。触って確かめず、見える範囲で形を描いておきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 展示番号と資料名を写し触らず見える形を描くと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will copy the exhibit number and artifact name into my notebook. I will draw its shape as far as I can see, without touching it to check.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will copy the exhibit number and artifact name and draw the visible shape without touching it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 説明札と番号を確かめながら記録してください。ほかの展示もどうぞお楽しみください。それでは、ごゆっくり。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please record it while checking the label and number. Enjoy the other exhibits too. Take your time.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらは荷物についてのご案内をお待ちの列です。どの便をご利用でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: This line is for people waiting for luggage information. Which service are you using?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗車する列だと思って並んでいました。大阪行きの便に乗りたいのですが、この列ではないのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗車列と思って並んだが大阪行きは別の列だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: I lined up thinking it was for boarding. I would like to take the Osaka service, but this is not the right line, then.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Confirm that you joined what you thought was the boarding line but the Osaka service uses a different line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 便の出発時刻と乗車券を確認させてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please let me check the departure time and your ticket.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 午後二時発の券です。座席番号は書いてありますが、乗り場の表示を見落としていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 午後二時発で座席番号があるが乗り場表示を見落としたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: My ticket is for the two p.m. departure. It has a seat number, but I overlooked the boarding-bay sign.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it departs at two p.m. and has a seat number, but you overlooked the boarding-bay information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご利用便の乗り場を案内板で確認しましょう。大きなお荷物はお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us check your service's boarding bay on the information board. Do you have any large luggage?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 小さいリュックだけです。荷物を預ける予定はないので、直接乗車の列へ行けますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 小さなリュックのみで預けないため直接乗車列へ行けるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: Just a small backpack. I do not plan to check any luggage, so may I go directly to the boarding line?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you only have a small backpack and will not check it, and ask whether you can go directly to the boarding line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 便ごとの手続きを確認してご案内します。案内板ではこちらの乗り場です。車体の行き先も確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check the procedures for your service and guide you. This is the bay on the information board. Please also check the destination on the vehicle.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 案内板と車体を両方見ます。乗車券は携帯画面ですが、乗る前に表示しておいた方がよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内板と車体を見て携帯の乗車券を事前表示すべきか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will look at both the board and the vehicle. My ticket is on my phone. Should I have it displayed before boarding?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will check both the board and vehicle, and ask whether to display your phone ticket in advance. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 確認の際にすぐ見せられるよう、ご準備ください。通信が必要な画面なら、開けることを今確かめておくと安心です。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please have it ready to show immediately when checked. If the screen requires a connection, checking now that you can open it is reassuring.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 券の画面を開けました。大阪行きと二時発の表示を確かめてから、正しい列の最後に並びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 券の画面を開き大阪行き二時発を確認して列の最後へ並ぶと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have opened the ticket screen. After checking that it says Osaka and a two o'clock departure, I will join the end of the correct line.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you opened the ticket screen and will check Osaka and the two o'clock departure before joining the end of the line. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 係員の案内に従ってお進みください。お乗り間違いのないようご確認を。それでは、よい旅を。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please proceed according to staff instructions. Check carefully so you do not board the wrong service. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 食券をお預かりします。こちらは大盛りですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will take your meal ticket. This is for a large serving, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 普通盛りを選ぶつもりで、大盛りを押してしまいました。まだ作り始めていなければ、量を変えられますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 大盛り食券を誤購入し調理前なら普通盛りへ変えたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: I meant to select a regular serving but pressed large by mistake. If cooking has not started yet, can the amount be changed?
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you bought a large-serving ticket by mistake and want to change to regular if cooking has not started. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 調理の状況と変更の扱いを確認します。麺だけ普通盛りにしたいというご希望でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the cooking status and how changes are handled. Would you like only the noodles changed to a regular serving?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、具はそのままで麺だけ普通にしたいです。食べ切れずに残すのが心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 具は変えず麺だけ普通にして食べ残しを避けたいと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, I want to keep the toppings the same and just have regular noodles. I am worried I will not finish it and leave food.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you want the same toppings with regular noodles to avoid leftovers. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 厨房ではまだ作り始めていません。差額の扱いも含めて確認しますので、この食券は一度お預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: The kitchen has not started yet. I will also check how the price difference is handled, so I will take this ticket for now.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。料金が戻るか分からなくても、まず麺の量を減らせることを確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 返金が未確定でも先に麺の量を減らせるか確認したいと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. Even though I do not know whether any money will be returned, I first want to check whether the noodle quantity can be reduced.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that even though a refund is unconfirmed, you first want to check whether the noodle quantity can be reduced. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 量の希望は厨房に伝えられます。料金についてはレジ担当に確認します。お待ちの間、お席はこちらでよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: I can tell the kitchen your preferred quantity. I will ask the cashier about the charge. Is this seat all right while you wait?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この席で待ちます。私の注文が大盛りのまま伝わらないよう、変更後の内容も教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 席で待つと答え大盛りのまま伝わらないよう変更後の内容を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will wait here. Please also tell me the amended order so it does not reach the kitchen as a large serving.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait at the seat and ask for the amended details so the order is not conveyed as large. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 注文は麺を普通の量、具はそのままと伝えました。料金の扱いが分かりましたら、改めてご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: I told them regular noodles with the same toppings. Once I know how the charge is handled, I will explain it to you separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 麺は普通で具はそのままですね。その内容でお願いします。料金の説明も聞いてから支払の確認をします。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 麺は普通で具はそのままを確認し料金説明後に支払も確かめると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: Regular noodles with the same toppings, then. Please proceed with that. After hearing the explanation of the charge, I will also check the payment.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm regular noodles and unchanged toppings, and say that you will check payment after hearing the charge explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: その内容でお作りします。説明のため後ほど伺いますね。それでは、どうぞごゆっくりお召し上がりください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: We will prepare it that way. I will come back later to explain. Please take your time and enjoy your meal.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 運搬の準備は進んでいますか。仮置き場所で気になることはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are preparations for carrying the materials progressing? Is there anything concerning you about the temporary storage area?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 指示された場所に板を置くと、歩く通路が狭くなりそうです。そのまま運ぶ前に確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 指定場所に板を置くと歩行通路が狭くなるため運搬前に確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: If we put the boards where instructed, it looks as though the walking passage will become narrow. I want to check before carrying them there.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that putting boards in the designated place would narrow the pedestrian passage and you want to check before carrying them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 搬入を始めずに確認しましょう。今、板はどこにありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let us check without starting delivery. Where are the boards now?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: まだトラックの荷台にあります。二人で下ろす予定ですが、通路の人が通ると置ける幅が足りません。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 板は荷台にあり二人で下ろすが人が通ると置く幅が足りないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Still on the truck bed. Two of us plan to unload them, but if people pass through the passage, there is not enough width to put them down.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the boards are on the truck and two people will unload them, but there is insufficient width when pedestrians pass. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 歩行経路を塞いではいけません。別の仮置き場所と、搬入する時間を調整します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: We must not obstruct the walking route. We will coordinate another temporary storage place and delivery time.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 奥の空き場所を使えそうに見えますが、私の判断では移さず、指定を待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 奥の空き場所が使えそうでも独断で移さず指示を待つと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: The open space at the back looks usable, but I will not move them on my own judgment. I will wait for a designated location.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that even if the open space at the back seems usable, you will not move things independently and will wait for instructions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: その場所は別の作業で使う予定があります。担当同士で確認するまで、荷下ろしを止めてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: That area is scheduled for other work. Please stop unloading until the responsible teams have checked with each other.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。運転手にも、まだ下ろさないと伝えます。待機中の車の位置も確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 運転手に荷下ろし保留を伝え待機車両の位置も確認したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. I will also tell the driver not to unload yet. I would like to check where the waiting vehicle should be too.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell the driver unloading is on hold and want to check the waiting vehicle's position. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 車両の担当へ確認します。あなたは安全な待機位置で、歩行者が作業範囲に入らないよう状況を知らせてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will check with the vehicle coordinator. Wait in a safe position and report the situation so pedestrians do not enter the work area.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 安全な位置で待ち、近づく人がいたら担当へ報告します。置き場と時間が決まってから荷下ろしを始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 安全位置で待ち接近者を担当へ報告し置き場と時間決定後に再開すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will wait in a safe position and report anyone approaching to the staff in charge. I will start unloading after the storage place and time are decided.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait safely, report approaching people, and resume only after the storage place and time are decided. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 再開の指示があるまで待機してください。声をかけてくれて助かりました。それでは、いったん失礼します。再開時も安全を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Remain on standby until instructed to resume. Thank you for speaking up. Excuse me for now. Let us check safety when restarting too.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 通帳の記録についてお尋ねですね。どの時期の取引をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-01.translation: You have a question about your passbook records. Which period's transactions are you looking for?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 春に受け取った入金を探しています。新しい通帳を見てもなくて、入っていないのか心配です。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 春に受け取った入金が新しい通帳になく未入金か心配と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am looking for a payment received in spring. I cannot find it in the new passbook, and I am worried it was not paid in.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that a spring payment is missing from your new passbook and you are worried it was not deposited. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 通帳を繰り越した時期は分かりますか。古い通帳もお持ちでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know when the passbook was renewed? Have you brought the old one too?

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 六月に新しくなりました。古い方も持ってきましたが、どちらを見ればよいか分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 六月に繰越し古い通帳もあるがどちらを見るか不明と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-04.translation: It was renewed in June. I brought the old one, but I do not know which to look at.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that it was renewed in June and you have the old passbook but do not know which one to check. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 春の記録なら繰越前の通帳にある可能性があります。まず入金を受け取る予定だった月を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-05.translation: Spring records may be in the passbook from before the renewal. First, let us check which month you expected the payment.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 四月末ごろです。三月の仕事の支払いなので、三月の記録だけを探していました。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 四月末の入金予定なのに三月の仕事のため三月の記録だけ探していたと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-06.translation: Around the end of April. It was payment for work in March, so I had only been searching the March records.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that although the expected payment was late April, you searched only March records because the work was done in March. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 仕事をした月と入金の月は別ですね。四月末付近の欄を見て、記載された日付と金額を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-07.translation: The month of the work and the month of the deposit are separate. Look near the end of April and check the dates and amounts recorded.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 古い通帳の四月三十日に、それらしい金額がありました。名前が短く表示されているので、これかどうか確かめたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 古い通帳の四月三十日に似た金額があり短い名義表示を確認したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-08.translation: There is a likely amount on April thirtieth in the old passbook. The name is abbreviated, so I want to check whether this is it.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that there is a similar amount on April thirtieth in the old passbook and you want to check the abbreviated name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示だけで支払元を断定せず、予定額や支払元からの案内と照合してください。必要な照会の手続きもご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-09.translation: Rather than concluding who paid from the display alone, compare it with the expected amount and information from the payer. We can also explain the procedures for any necessary inquiry.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: まず会社の支払明細と日付と金額を比べます。別の入金だった場合だけ、照会の方法を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会社の明細と日付と額を比べ別の入金なら照会方法を相談すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-10.translation: First, I will compare the date and amount with the company's payment statement. Only if it turns out to be a different deposit will I ask how to make an inquiry.
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will compare the company's statement, date, and amount, and discuss an inquiry if it is a different deposit. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 二冊の通帳をお返しします。照合して分からなければ、対象の日付を控えてご相談ください。それでは、お気をつけて。
DLG-SC-LOC-036-21-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here are your two passbooks back. If comparing them does not resolve it, note the date in question and consult us. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今の放送について、ご確認されたいことがありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check about the announcement just now?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 乗り場が変わったと聞こえました。私が乗る列車のことか分からないので、この券を見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 乗り場変更の放送が自分の列車か分からず券の確認を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I heard that a boarding location had changed. I do not know whether it was about my train, so could you look at this ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you do not know whether the boarding-location change announcement concerns your train and ask for your ticket to be checked. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 列車名と出発時刻を確認しますね。どの表示を見てここまで来られましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will check the train name and departure time. Which sign did you follow to get here?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入口の案内板を見て来ました。今の放送の前に見たので、表示が変わっているかもしれません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 放送前に入口の案内板を見たため表示が変わった可能性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: I looked at the information board at the entrance. That was before the announcement, so the display may have changed.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you checked the entrance board before the announcement and its display may have changed. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 放送の内容と現在の表示を照合します。確認が済むまで、ホームへの移動はお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will compare the announcement with the current display. Please wait before moving to the platform until we have checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ここで待ちます。同行者は先にホームへ行ったので、確認してから電話で知らせたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 確認まで待ち先にホームへ行った同行者へ後で電話したいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will wait here. My companion went to the platform first, so I would like to call and tell them after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will wait for confirmation and then call the companion who has already gone to the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 今回の変更は別の列車でした。お持ちの券の列車は、今の案内板で乗り場を確かめましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: This change concerned a different train. For the train on your ticket, let us check the boarding location on the current information board.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 別の列車だったのですね。この券と同じ列車名と時刻の行を見ればよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 変更が別列車と確認し券の列車名と時刻で案内板の行を探すか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: It was a different train, then. Should I find the row with the same train name and time as on this ticket?
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm that the change was for a different train and ask whether to find the board row matching your ticket's train name and time. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい、両方が一致していることをご確認ください。ホームでも行き先と列車名を見てからお乗りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes, please check that both match. On the platform too, check the destination and train name before boarding.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内板の列車名と時刻が一致しました。同行者にも変更の対象ではなかったと伝え、ホームでまた表示を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内板と券が一致したと伝え同行者へ連絡しホームでも表示を確認すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: The train name and time on the board match. I will tell my companion our train was not affected, and check the display again on the platform.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that the board matches the ticket, you will contact your companion, and will check the display on the platform too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: では、余裕を持って移動してください。放送があれば再度ご確認を。それでは、よい旅になりますように。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please move with time to spare. If there is another announcement, check again. Have a good trip.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察前に、現在お使いのお薬について伺います。情報が分かるものはお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Before the consultation, I will ask about medicines you currently use. Have you brought anything with that information?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 薬の手帳を家に忘れました。毎日飲む薬がありますが、名前を正確に覚えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 薬の手帳を忘れ毎日の薬名を正確に覚えていないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left my medication record book at home. I take medicine every day but do not remember the name accurately.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you forgot your medication record book and do not accurately remember the name of your daily medication. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 覚えている範囲を伺い、分からない部分は未確認として伝えます。薬の袋や写真はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: I will ask what you remember and pass on unclear parts as unconfirmed. Do you have the medicine bag or a photograph?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯に袋の写真が一枚あります。ただ、去年の写真なので、今も同じ薬か自信がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 去年の薬袋の写真はあるが現在と同じ薬か自信がないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: I have one photo of the bag on my phone. However, it is from last year, so I am not sure it is the same medicine I use now.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have a photo of last year's medicine bag but are unsure whether it matches your current medicine. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 古い写真だけで現在の薬を決めず、情報の日付も含めて担当者に伝えましょう。ご自宅で確認してくれる方はいますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let us tell the staff the date of the information too, rather than identify the current medicine from an old photo alone. Is anyone at home who can check for you?

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夫が家にいます。手帳の最新のページを撮って送ってもらうことはできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家にいる夫から手帳の最新ページの写真を送ってもらえると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: My husband is home. He can photograph the latest page of the record book and send it to me.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that your husband at home can send a photo of the latest page of your medication book. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 診察前に確認できるか相談します。ご連絡する際は、氏名と日付の見える最新のページをお願いしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will discuss whether we can check it before the consultation. When you contact him, ask for the latest page with your name and the date visible.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 夫に電話します。写真が間に合わなければ、名前を推測して問診票に書かず、分からないと伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 夫へ連絡し写真が間に合わなければ薬名を推測せず不明と伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will call my husband. If the photo does not arrive in time, I will not guess a name and write it on the questionnaire; I will say I do not know.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will contact your husband and, if the photo is late, report the name as unknown rather than guessing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: そうしてください。服用の判断は診察する担当者にご相談ください。情報が届いたらこちらにお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please do. Discuss decisions about taking medicine with the clinician seeing you. Let us know when the information arrives.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 届いた写真の日付も確認してお見せします。今日は薬を増やしたり減らしたりせず、担当者の説明を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 届いた写真の日付を確かめて見せ服薬を独断で変更せず説明を聞きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: I will also check the date of the photo that arrives before showing it. Today I want to hear the staff's explanation without increasing or reducing my medicine myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the received photo's date and show it, and want an explanation without independently changing medication. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 情報の不足も含めて診察の担当者へお伝えします。それでは、順番までこちらでお待ちください。お大事に。
DLG-SC-LOC-037-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will tell the clinician about the missing information as well. Please wait here until your turn. Take care of yourself.
